note: Milestones as published by each authority. Verify against the current edition of each source before relying on a date for compliance decisions.

milestones.title: Mitigate quantum risk across federal systems
milestones.detail: National Security Memorandum 10 sets the goal of mitigating as much quantum risk as feasible by 2035.
milestones.source: National Security Memorandum 10 (May 2022)

milestones.title: First post-quantum standards published
milestones.detail: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA) become final standards.
milestones.source: NIST FIPS 203, FIPS 204, FIPS 205

milestones.title: Transition timeline proposed
milestones.detail: NIST IR 8547 (initial public draft) proposes deprecating and then disallowing quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms.
milestones.source: NIST IR 8547 ipd, Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards

milestones.title: HQC selected as backup KEM
milestones.detail: HQC is selected for standardisation as a code-based alternative to ML-KEM.
milestones.source: NIST IR 8545

milestones.title: 112-bit RSA and ECC deprecated
milestones.detail: Quantum-vulnerable digital signature and key-establishment algorithms at the 112-bit security level are deprecated after 2030.
milestones.source: NIST IR 8547 ipd

milestones.title: All quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms disallowed
milestones.detail: RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA, DH and ECDH are disallowed after 2035 at every security level.
milestones.source: NIST IR 8547 ipd

milestones.title: Software and firmware signing: support and prefer
milestones.detail: Software and firmware signing, web browsers, servers and cloud services should support and prefer CNSA 2.0 algorithms by 2025.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 Suite advisory

milestones.title: Networking equipment: support and prefer
milestones.detail: Traditional networking equipment such as VPNs and routers should support and prefer CNSA 2.0 by 2026.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 Suite advisory

milestones.title: New NSS acquisitions must be CNSA 2.0 compliant
milestones.detail: New equipment acquired for National Security Systems must be CNSA 2.0 compliant.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 FAQ

milestones.title: Operating systems: support and prefer
milestones.detail: Operating systems should support and prefer CNSA 2.0 algorithms by 2027.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 Suite advisory

milestones.title: Signing and networking: CNSA 2.0 exclusively
milestones.detail: Software and firmware signing and traditional networking equipment use CNSA 2.0 exclusively by 2030.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 Suite advisory

milestones.title: Browsers, servers, cloud and operating systems: exclusively
milestones.detail: Web browsers, servers, cloud services, operating systems and niche equipment use CNSA 2.0 exclusively, and custom and legacy applications are updated or replaced, by 2033.
milestones.source: NSA CNSA 2.0 Suite advisory

milestones.title: Begin the transition
milestones.detail: Member States start transitioning: national plans, cryptographic inventories and first steps completed by the end of 2026.
milestones.source: Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (NIS Cooperation Group, June 2025)

milestones.title: High-risk use cases migrated
milestones.detail: High-risk use cases complete their transition to post-quantum cryptography by the end of 2030.
milestones.source: Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (NIS Cooperation Group, June 2025)

milestones.title: As many systems as feasible migrated
milestones.detail: Medium-risk use cases, and as many systems as feasible, transition by 2035.
milestones.source: Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (NIS Cooperation Group, June 2025)

milestones.title: Discovery complete and migration goals defined
milestones.detail: Organisations define migration goals, complete discovery of their cryptographic estate and build an initial plan by 2028.
milestones.source: NCSC, Timelines for migration to post-quantum cryptography (March 2025)

milestones.title: Highest-priority migration complete
milestones.detail: Early, highest-priority migration activities are complete and the plan is refined by 2031.
milestones.source: NCSC, Timelines for migration to post-quantum cryptography (March 2025)

milestones.title: Migration complete
milestones.detail: Migration to post-quantum cryptography is complete for all systems, services and products by 2035.
milestones.source: NCSC, Timelines for migration to post-quantum cryptography (March 2025)

milestones.title: Departmental migration plans
milestones.detail: Federal departments develop their post-quantum migration plans by April 2026.
milestones.source: ITSM.40.001, Roadmap for the migration to post-quantum cryptography for the Government of Canada

milestones.title: High-priority systems migrated
milestones.detail: Migration of high-priority systems completes by the end of 2031.
milestones.source: ITSM.40.001, Roadmap for the migration to post-quantum cryptography for the Government of Canada

milestones.title: All remaining systems migrated
milestones.detail: Migration of remaining systems completes by the end of 2035.
milestones.source: ITSM.40.001, Roadmap for the migration to post-quantum cryptography for the Government of Canada

milestones.title: Traditional asymmetric cryptography retired
milestones.detail: Traditional asymmetric cryptography such as RSA, ECDH and ECDSA is not approved for use beyond 2030.
milestones.source: Australian Signals Directorate, Information Security Manual (December 2024 update)
